scope: New activation code only; accepted product tests were not rerun. All probes used isolated temporary fixture data under the ordinary MCP identity.

initial_material_finding.title: Root mode=ro SQLite can create live WAL/SHM owned by root
initial_material_finding.setup: An isolated WAL-mode SQLite database was created, populated, committed and closed. Both WAL and SHM were absent. The exact pinned controller function backed it up and performed its isolated restore check.
initial_material_finding.production_risk: The draft production entry point requires UID0. Applying the same source-open behavior there could create root-owned live auxiliaries and obstruct the service owner. The production UID0 case was not executed.
initial_material_finding.required_correction: Open live SQLite under its existing service owner; retain normal WAL visibility; keep root SQLite operations confined to private copies. Do not use immutable=1 for live WAL.

resolution.detail: All live SQLite opens moved to the hash-pinned fixed service-identity helper. The parent passes verified source through stdin using the existing sudo -u mcpdev Python isolation pattern; root SQLite opens only private copied snapshots. Actual same-UID WAL tests passed. No immutable=1 or live permission change was introduced.

focused_positive_helper_cases.method: A real subprocess imported the exact pinned helper. os.geteuid/os.getegid were not mocked. Internal snapshot_bytes was pointed at isolated fixed-name fixture databases. The production CLI and its fixed live BASE were not invoked.

additional_material_finding.title: Backup completeness accepted an omitted actual database receipt and files
additional_material_finding.required_correction: Require the actual databases mapping to contain exactly all eleven required names before verifying every backup and restore copy.
additional_material_finding.method: The real fixture backup completed. Only the isolated private fixture receipt was edited to omit webui.db; both matching fixture backup and restore files were removed. The uncorrected prepared() accepted it.

resolution.detail: Controller.prepared now requires the actual databases mapping to match exactly all eleven fixed names. The final focused regression removes both the actual webui backup/restore and its map entry and verifies rejection.

independent_crash_recovery_case.method: Real temporary file operations and SQLite backups; an injected crash immediately after atomic new-module link creation left the exact owned candidate inode with two links. Direct rollback used the actual controller recovery logic with a deterministic service emulator.
independent_crash_recovery_case.limitation: Service stop/start was emulated; no real systemd process or production source was changed.

final_test_evidence_independently_inspec.scope: Complete new activation suite before the final backup-map and streaming guards. Actual temporary files/SQLite and same-UID subprocesses; systemd lifecycle emulated.
